description: Combine the accepted n1024 custom-all selective-correction path with the n512 full-spectrum width-16 generalized Rayleigh-Ritz repair: transplant exact cause/column flags, hybrid high-accuracy AQ plus strict G/H whitening and rotation, compact Newton, and reduced fallback; reconcile extension workspaces and dispatch; preserve n1024 class shifts, all other size routes, exact certificates, guards, and CUDA portability; then profile integration effects.

Combined the accepted n1024 custom-all selective-correction parent with the n512 exact cause/column export and full-spectrum width-16 generalized Rayleigh-Ritz repair. Preserved n1024 class shifts, dense/custom dispatch, exact certificates, guards, and all other size routes; adopted the n512 parent interface with independent refinement scratch. Clean build and kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 25324.091176 us versus first-parent 25387.135 us; n512 mixed/rankdef/dense-even 98498.252/95897.568/55964.512 us and n1024 mixed/nearrank/geometric 103091.621/44898.122/95434.416 us. Mixed n512 nsys profile retains sytrd factor panels 27.4%, clustered reorthogonalization 9.3%, selective sytrd4 fallback 3.7%, and prefix reduction 3.5%; generalized eig/certificate/Newton kernels are individually sub-percent.

Reconciled the combined extension workspaces by returning the existing n512 reduction matrix and reusing its leading candidate slice as alternating Newton scratch, removing one full candidate-sized allocation without changing cause/column flags, generalized width-16 repair, certificates, fallback, n1024 dispatch, or other routes. Clean build and kernelguard; validation 39/39. Initial full metric 25298.336825 us and exact-head replay 25256.194236 us versus direct-merge 25324.091176 and first-parent 25387.135; sub-1% deltas are within documented noise. Replay n512 mixed/rankdef/dense-even 98375.468/95991.491/55928.512 us and n1024 mixed/nearrank/geometric 102846.048/44723.616/93712.477 us. Final mixed n512 profile is stable: factor sytrd panels 27.3%, clustered reorthogonalization 9.6%, selective sytrd4 fallback 3.7%, prefix reduction 3.5%, width-16 Jacobi 0.5%, and certificate/Newton kernels below 1%.

Released the reused n512 reduction workspace immediately after C++ refinement returns so the stream-aware allocator can recycle it during Python generalized repair; numerical operations, exact cause/column flags, hybrid AQ/strict geometry, compact Newton, fallback, and every dispatch remain unchanged. Clean build and kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 25318.586725 us, within documented noise of retained-workspace 25298.336825/25256.194236 and direct-merge 25324.091176. n512 mixed/rankdef/dense-even 98427.513/95972.822/55881.104 us; n1024 mixed/nearrank/geometric 103601.007/44851.083/95798.164 us. Final nsys profile remains stable: factor sytrd panels 27.4%, clustered reorthogonalization 9.5%, selective sytrd4 fallback 3.7%, prefix reduction 3.5%, width-16 Jacobi 0.6%, and Newton 1.0%.

Provisionally worked through the two-parent integration in three committed trials. Direct merge dff430b2209d91bc860369a30a5860b72c763c98 transplanted exact n512 cause/column flags, hybrid high-accuracy AQ plus strict width-16 G/H whitening/rotation, compact Newton, and reduced selective fallback onto the accepted n1024 custom-all parent; it scored 25324.091176 us. Workspace-reuse commit 4d9a965f28fde64f45ed0926bb7b77e182bbee11 removed one candidate-sized allocation by reusing the existing n512 reduction matrix; it measured 25298.336825 us and replayed at the brief-best 25256.194236 us. Final commit ea98061c650da553535443a99cf72667aad5a9f6 additionally releases that workspace reference before generalized repair and measured 25318.586725 us; all sub-1% spread is within documented noise. Every trial built cleanly, passed kernelguard and validation 39/39, and preserved n1024 class shifts, dense/custom dispatch, all other size routes, exact certificates, fallback, and portability. Final mixed n512 profile: factor sytrd panels 27.4%, clustered reorthogonalization 9.5%, remaining sytrd4 fallback 3.7%, prefix reduction 3.5%, width-16 Jacobi 0.6%. Final mixed n1024 profile: clustered panel reduction 34.3%, cuSOLVER symv 12.6%, GEMV 8.7%, remaining sytrd4 fallback 4.3%, tridiagonal eig 4.0%. Keep the run moving with ncu on the dominant n512 sytrd factor panel and n1024 clustered reducer, a measured reduction of n512 reorthogonalization/fallback survivors, and host-allocation/API profiling of retained-versus-early-release workspace lifetime; scratch carving from existing certificate buffers and an n1024 panel/GEMV fusion remain concrete integration follow-ups. No leaderboard submission was made.

Instrumented the live n512 dispatcher with an environment-gated PyTorch CPU-memory profile and captured the official mixed batch. With profiling disabled, build/kernelguard and validation passed 39/39 and the full metric was 25305.675871 us. The mixed capture measured 39 aten::empty calls (1108.6 us), 19 empty_strided calls (490.8 us), and 17 resize_ calls (87.8 us). Around generalized repair specifically, first recertification allocated two [88,512,512] empty_like outputs and spent 175.9 us in nonzero; second recertification allocated two [52,512,512] empty_like outputs, spent 18.8 us on the materialized Rayleigh product and 143.8 us reducing it, then cloned 52 flags. This confirms CPU/PyTorch tensor metadata and operator-launch churn that cuda,nvtx API tracing did not expose.

Moved first and second n512 recertification into independent grow-only extension states with out-buffer Gram/AQ/Rayleigh operations and CUB flag compaction. The CUDA extension built successfully, but the harness banned-construct guard rejected explicit at::cuda current-stream handling at lines 3760-3780 because leaderboard submissions may not reference streams. Numerical tests and benchmarks were not run; the next revision must use the existing default-launch convention.

The guard-compatible version uses the established default launch convention. Clean build/kernelguard; validation 39/39. Full metric 25279.188350 us, with n512 mixed 97961.020 us versus selected 4de0cc8f mixed median 98263.507 us; aggregate deltas remain within documented noise.
